payload.subject: PO triage of USER coverage-gap concern (2026-05-26): two decisions dispatched. ITEM A routed to agent-father (this signal); ITEM B re-dispatched to agents-architect (DASHBOARD row 1965-COVERAGE-SWEEP).

decisions.name: MARKET-SLOTS-DARK-20260526T0203Z
decisions.decision: OPTION (A) — RE-ENABLE the 4 dark market-hours slots. Options B (recreate RemoteTriggers) and C (accept+document gap) REJECTED.
decisions.action: Edit docs/data/cowork-schedule.json for the 4 slots: news-scout-market, market-watcher-market, alert-commander-market (all '*/15 2-8 * * 1-5'), market-watcher-prepost ('*/30 * * * 1-5'). For each: set enabled=true, delete _disabled_by, delete trigger_error, add _superseded_by='cowork-dispatcher' + trigger_status='deleted' (parity with other dispatcher-owned slots). ALSO clean the stale _notes.phase2_residual_2026_05_20 claim ('12 RemoteTriggers still exist') — it is live-falsified (RemoteTrigger list = []).
rationale: Disable reason '_disabled_by: API_MIN_INTERVAL' is SELF-CONTRADICTED by the schedule's own _runtime note (line 4): the */15 CronCreate dispatcher 'Replaces per-slot RemoteTrigger model' and exists precisely to OWN sub-hourly firing. The 1h API floor applied to per-slot RemoteTriggers, not the dispatcher path.

Documented fallback is DEAD: live RemoteTrigger action=list returns {"data":[]} — ZERO triggers. Option B would resurrect the deprecated per-slot path + the double-publish/MARKET-spam risk the original AC-6 concern warned about.

Mitigation the original hold waited for is PROVEN this session: 00:00Z dispatcher fan-out ran 3 GENUINE cowork agents and the anti-hollow-run gate caught news-scout's false-CRITICAL (see NEWSFETCH-FALSECRIT-20260526T0012Z). That is the AC-6 evidence.
Option C unacceptable: leaves intraday cowork intelligence (news / anomaly scans / verified-chain alerts) DARK 02:00-08:30Z weekdays. Reliability + coverage are the top product priorities.
decisions.constraint: A ONLY — do NOT do A+B both (double-publish risk). Validate JSON parses + zero duplicate keys post-edit; commit explicit-add only (never -A).
decisions.note: Small well-specified data edit on existing slots. cowork-schedule.json SSOT header reserves edits to agent-father (_maintained_by). PO does NOT self-edit it.

decisions.name: 1965-COVERAGE-SWEEP
decisions.decision: RE-DISPATCH agents-architect against the EXISTING OPEN DASHBOARD row 1965-COVERAGE-SWEEP (## agents-architect section). The row was authored 2026-05-21 but never picked up; the brief was never produced.
decisions.correction_to_task_framing: User-supplied task said the 1965-COVERAGE-SWEEP DASHBOARD row was 'never created' — FALSIFIED: the row EXISTS and is still OPEN. Only the brief file docs/architecture-briefs/2026-05-21-cowork-coverage-sweep.md was never produced.
decisions.root_cause_confirmed: Cowork analysis agents are signal-GATED, not roster-driven: market-watcher fires only on >sigma moves; news-scout only on tickers appearing in news; financial-analyst/report-analyzer only on report arrival; CHEF synthesizes only already-signalled tickers. Quiet tickers (no move/no news/no report) get ZERO coverage. No periodic full-roster sweep guarantees each of the 34 active watchlist tickers is touched on a bounded cadence.
decisions.design_ask: Minimum-coverage rotation policy layered UNDER the existing event-driven path (do NOT suppress news/anomaly/report fires) so the full 34-ticker roster (system-map .project.watchlist len=34) is swept on a bounded daily/weekly cadence without spamming MARKET. e.g. per-cycle round-robin slice of N tickers. agents-architect outputs the brief; agent-father implements the flow.md edits (news-scout.md + market-watcher.md). agents-architect does NOT edit flows directly.

payload.po_boundary: PO wrote NO production code and did NOT self-edit any agent-system config (cowork-schedule.json owned by agent-father; flows owned by agent-father; brief owned by agents-architect). PO only triaged + routed + updated DASHBOARD + emitted this signal.
